```{r}
library(tidyverse)

library(rstatix)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

library(BayesFactor)

library(ggthemes)
library(extrafont)
```

## Load data og præprocessering

```{r}

df_binaural_eeg <- read_csv("data/eegbinaural_ses1_20260508_092645.csv")
df_control_eeg  <- read_csv("data/eegcontrol_ses1_20260508_084700.csv")

df_binaural_eeg$participant_id <- "eeg"
df_control_eeg$participant_id <- "eeg"

df_binaural_eeg$condition <- "binaural"
df_control_eeg$condition  <- "control"

df_binaural_david <- read_csv("data/David_binarual_ses1_20260514_172049.csv")
df_control_david <- read_csv("data/Johan_control_ses1_20260514_132716.csv")

df_binaural_david$participant_id <- "david"
df_control_david$participant_id <- "david"

df_binaural_david$condition <- "binaural"
df_control_david$condition  <- "control"

raw_df <- bind_rows(df_binaural_eeg, df_control_eeg, df_binaural_david, df_control_david)
```

```{r}
raw_df <- raw_df |>
  
  filter(
    is_practice == FALSE,
    reaction_time < 2,
    reaction_time > 0.15
  ) |>
  
  mutate(
    ID = factor(participant_id),
    condition = factor(condition),
    coherence = factor(coherence),
    accuracy = as.numeric(accuracy),
    log_rt = log(reaction_time)
  )
```

```{r}
raw_df |> summarise_all(n_distinct)
```

## Accuracy Analyse

```{r}
accuracy_fig <- raw_df |>
  
  group_by(ID, condition, coherence) |>
  summarise(mean_accuracy = mean(accuracy), .groups = "drop") |>
  
  ggplot(aes(x = coherence,
             y = mean_accuracy,
             fill = condition)) +
  
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6,
               outlier.alpha = 0.2) +
  
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 23,
    size = 3,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~condition) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Accuracy across coherence levels",
    subtitle = "White diamond indicates group mean",
    y = "Mean Accuracy",
    x = "Coherence"
  ) +
  
  theme_fivethirtyeight() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    text = element_text(family = "IBM Plex Mono")
  )

accuracy_fig
```

```{r}
anova_data <- raw_df |>
  
  group_by(ID, condition, coherence) |>
  
  summarise(
    mean_accuracy = mean(accuracy),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

accuracy_anova <- anova_data |>
  
  anova_test(
    dv = mean_accuracy,
    wid = ID,
    within = c(condition, coherence),
    effect.size = "ges"
  )

get_anova_table(accuracy_anova)
```

```{r}
accuracy_lmm <- lmer(
  
  accuracy ~ condition * coherence +
    
    (1 | ID),
  
  data = raw_df
)

summary(accuracy_lmm)
```

```{r}
participant_accuracy <- raw_df |>
  
  group_by(ID, condition) |>
  
  summarise(
    mean_accuracy = mean(accuracy),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

participant_accuracy |>
  
  ggplot(aes(
    x = condition,
    y = mean_accuracy,
    group = ID
  )) +
  
  geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = 1),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 2
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Individual Differences in Binaural Effect",
    subtitle = "Grey lines = participants, red = group average",
    y = "Mean Accuracy"
  ) +
  
  theme_fivethirtyeight() +
  
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "IBM Plex Mono")
  )
```

## Reaction Time Analyse

```{r}
rt_fig <- raw_df |>
  
  filter(accuracy == 1) |>
  
  ggplot(aes(
    x = condition,
    y = reaction_time,
    fill = condition
  )) +
  
  geom_violin(
    alpha = 0.5,
    trim = FALSE
  ) +
  
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.1,
    fill = "white",
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~coherence) +
  
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 2)) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Reaction Time by Condition",
    subtitle = "Correct trials only",
    y = "Reaction Time (seconds)",
    x = "Condition"
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  
  theme_fivethirtyeight() +
  
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "IBM Plex Mono")
  )

rt_fig
```

```{r}
rt_bayes_data <- raw_df |>
  
  filter(accuracy == 1) |>
  
  group_by(ID, condition, coherence) |>
  
  summarise(
    mean_rt = mean(reaction_time),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  
  mutate(
    ID = factor(ID),
    condition = factor(condition),
    coherence = factor(coherence)
  ) |>
  
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r}
rt_bf_model <- anovaBF(
  
  mean_rt ~ condition * coherence + ID,
  
  data = rt_bayes_data,
  
  whichRandom = "ID",
  
  progress = FALSE
)

print(rt_bf_model)
```

```{r}
rt_bf_model / rt_bf_model[1]
```

```{r}
accuracy_bayes_data <- raw_df |>
  
  group_by(ID, condition, coherence) |>
  
  summarise(
    mean_accuracy = mean(accuracy),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  
  mutate(
    ID = factor(ID),
    condition = factor(condition),
    coherence = factor(coherence)
  ) |>
  
  as.data.frame()

accuracy_bf_model <- anovaBF(
  
  mean_accuracy ~ condition * coherence + ID,
  
  data = accuracy_bayes_data,
  
  whichRandom = "ID",
  
  progress = FALSE
)

print(accuracy_bf_model)
```
